_comment: Single source of truth for the published template addresses the demos / scripts / web dashboard fall back to when no env override is set. When a template is republished (e.g. after a testnet reset), update it here ONCE instead of editing each consumer. Per-consumer env vars still win over these: BUDGET_TEMPLATE / AGENT_TEMPLATE / AGENTPAY_BUDGET_TEMPLATE (agent_budget), ESCROW_TEMPLATE (escrow). Only the supported product line (agent_budget + escrow) is tracked here; the frozen OtcBoard demo and the throwaway call-escrow.py keep their own literals. These are the localnet addresses from README.md; esmeralda addresses are set via env.
